ctx.x: But he had all of the good musicians, you know, Chicago had -- let's see, when he was in Chicago we had Willie Randall, Bud Johnson, of course, and I think Syd Catlett played with him for awhile, also. But just all the best musicians. And I left Chicago with Roy and toured for awhile, and I think my next trip was to Detroit. And we picked up a couple of musicians there, Gerald Wilson, and another -- a saxophone player by the name of Billie Bowen.

B-o-w-e-n, Bowen. Bowen. And we toured around the country. This is the first time I met you know, Gerald Wilson, the trumpet player. And of course they all -- it was such a privilege for them to work with Roy Eldridge, you know, so we laugh about that, Gerald and I now, because when I was on his show he was just -- he was reminiscent about Detroit. Detroit had some very good musicians also. And I went to New York, the first time I was in New York I went with Roy, as I told you, and we toured around all the…
